meta.value:
"""Final v3 datasets: all 48 RR pressure moments (s38), area summary, gap-weighted 'fix it' top 10s of players RR can buy,
RR's own squad on the same score, and the auction plan rebuilt on those scores.
Caps are our recommendation (need priority + 2026 contract anchors), not price predictions. Ages approximate, 2027 season."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, pathlib
W = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/work"); O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash9"); O.mkdir(exist_ok=True); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
MT = pd.read_csv(W / "all_moments.csv"); TH = pd.read_csv(W / "moment_themes.csv"); F = pd.read_csv(W / "fix_scores.csv"); R = pd.read_csv(W / "rivals2027.csv")
NOTE = {"Faf du Plessis": "Skipped IPL 2026; check he registers", "Mustafizur Rahman": "Check availability (Bangladesh)", "Ishant Sharma": "Age 38", "Glenn Maxwell": "Age 38; must register"}
F["note"] = F.name.map(NOTE).fillna("")
F["overseas"] = np.where(F.country == "India", "Indian", "Overseas")
F["fixes"] = F.fixes.fillna("")
avail = F[~F.status.isin(["RR 2027 squad", "Retained by another team"])].copy()
tops = []
for side in ("batting", "bowling"):
    a = avail[avail.side == side].sort_values("score", ascending=False).head(10).copy(); a["rank"] = range(1, 11); tops.append(a)
TOP = pd.concat(tops)
RRS = F[F.status == "RR 2027 squad"].sort_values(["side", "score"], ascending=[True, False])
PLAN = [
 (1, "Overseas finisher for the last two overs", "Batting: last two overs (1.54 wins a season)", 7.5, [
   ("A", "Glenn Maxwell", "batting", "The only available batter who clearly fixes the last two overs: +15.1, strike rate 188 in RR's moments (245 balls). Also bowls off-spin.", "Not registered, or price passes 7.5 cr"),
   ("B", "M Shahrukh Khan", "batting", "Indian, strike rate 172 in the moments, but loses his wicket often (every 12.6 balls), so his score is slightly below the league (-0.76).", "Price passes 4 cr"),
   ("C", "Rachin Ravindra", "batting", "Left-hander, strike rate 162 in the moments; close to the league (-0.51).", "Price passes 4 cr")]),
 (2, "Middle-overs rebuilder (right-hander, overs 7-10 after early wickets)", "Batting: middle overs (0.56 wins a season)", 4.0, [
   ("A", "Shai Hope", "batting", "Best available rebuilder: +1.79, out only every 31 balls in RR's middle-overs moments. Keeps wicket too.", "Price passes 4 cr, or slot 3 needs the overseas place"),
   ("B", "Karun Nair", "batting", "Indian, +0.93 on a small sample (38 balls), strike rate 147.", "Price passes 2 cr"),
   ("C", "Rahul Tripathi", "batting", "Indian, +0.26, out every 34 balls.", "Price passes 1.5 cr")]),
 (3, "Overseas death bowler (overs 16-18, close games)", "Bowling: death (0.41 wins a season)", 8.5, [
   ("A", "Matheesha Pathirana", "bowling", "+2.77 across RR's bowling moments over 786 balls, economy 8.1, a wicket every 11.7 balls; pressure rank 13.", "Price passes 8.5 cr"),
   ("B", "Gerald Coetzee", "bowling", "+1.71 over 511 balls, economy 8.9; 26 years old.", "Price passes 6 cr"),
   ("C", "Spencer Johnson", "bowling", "Left-arm angle, +1.46 over 258 balls.", "Price passes 4 cr"),
   ("D", "Mitchell Starc", "bowling", "+1.16 over 433 balls; Trent Boult is just behind (+0.90).", "Price passes 6 cr")]),
 (4, "Indian pacer for close games and the death", "Bowling: death and close games", 3.5, [
   ("A", "Ishant Sharma", "bowling", "Best Indian in RR's bowling moments: +3.57 over 352 balls, economy 8.6. Age 38, so a one- or two-season buy.", "Price passes 3.5 cr"),
   ("B", "Avesh Khan", "bowling", "+1.19 over 862 balls; younger (30) but costlier (Rs 9.75 cr in 2026).", "Price passes 5 cr (use the slot 1-3 savings)"),
   ("C", "Mohit Sharma", "bowling", "+0.55 over 540 balls, economy 9.7; age 38.", "Price passes 1.5 cr")]),
 (5, "Middle-overs spinner against left-handed No. 3-4", "Bowling: middle overs (0.32 wins a season)", 1.5, [
   ("A", "Mayank Markande", "bowling", "Indian leg-spinner, slightly above the league (+0.18); cheap.", "Price passes 1.5 cr"),
   ("B", "Keshav Maharaj", "bowling", "+2.64, the best spinner in RR's moments, but overseas: only if slot 2 went to an Indian.", "No overseas place left"),
   ("C", "George Linde", "bowling", "+1.61, overseas left-arm spinner; same overseas condition.", "No overseas place left")]),
 (6, "Back-up pacer", "Bowling: new ball and death", 0.75, [
   ("A", "Mohit Sharma", "bowling", "If not bought in slot 4: +0.55, experienced at the death.", "Price passes 0.75 cr"),
   ("B", "Karn Sharma", "bowling", "Leg-spinner, +0.71 in RR's death moments.", "Price passes 0.5 cr"),
   ("C", "Best uncapped pacer in the 3 December register", "bowling", "Too few balls in the data pack to rank uncapped players; scout the register.", "")]),
]
AGE = {"Glenn Maxwell": 38, "M Shahrukh Khan": 31, "Rachin Ravindra": 27, "Shai Hope": 33, "Karun Nair": 35, "Rahul Tripathi": 35, "Matheesha Pathirana": 24,
       "Gerald Coetzee": 26, "Spencer Johnson": 31, "Mitchell Starc": 36, "Ishant Sharma": 38, "Avesh Khan": 30, "Mohit Sharma": 38, "Mayank Markande": 29,
       "Keshav Maharaj": 36, "George Linde": 35, "Karn Sharma": 39}
COMP = {1: "compete_N1", 2: "compete_N1", 3: "compete_N3", 4: "compete_N3", 5: "compete_N4", 6: "compete_N5"}
rows = []
for slot, need, area, cap, opts in PLAN:
    for opt, nm, side, why, sw in opts:
        x = F[(F.name == nm) & (F.side == side)]
        ovs = x.overseas.iat[0] if len(x) else "Indian"
        riv = R[(R[COMP[slot]] >= 0.15) & (R.team != "Rajasthan Royals") & ((R.overseas_slots > 0) if ovs == "Overseas" else True)].sort_values(COMP[slot], ascending=False).team.tolist()
        rows.append({"slot": slot, "need": need, "fixes": area, "slot_cap_cr": cap, "option": opt, "player": nm, "overseas": ovs, "age": AGE.get(nm),
                     "status": x.status.iat[0] if len(x) else "In the 3 Dec register", "fix_score": round(x.score.iat[0], 2) if len(x) else None,
                     "moment_balls": int(x.balls.iat[0]) if len(x) else None, "stat": round(x.stat.iat[0], 1) if len(x) else None,
                     "likely_rivals": ", ".join(riv[:3]) or "Few", "why": why, "switch_when": sw})
P = pd.DataFrame(rows); P.to_csv(W / "auction_plan_v3.csv", index=False)
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rws = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rws, "meta": [{"label": "s39_final_v3.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rws))
mt = MT.copy(); mt["side"] = mt.side.str.capitalize()
for c in ["rr", "champ", "league", "rr2", "champ2", "league2", "rr_wins_lost", "champ_wins", "luck_pct", "sure_pct", "gap_per_ball"]: mt[c] = mt[c].round(2)
dump("all_moments", mt[["id", "side", "theme", "label", "src", "rr_wins_lost", "champ_wins", "luck_pct", "sure_pct", "rr_balls", "stat", "rr", "champ", "league", "stat2", "rr2", "champ2", "league2", "gap_per_ball", "explanation"]],
     "all_moments.csv (s38_all_moments.py)")
th = TH.copy(); th["side"] = th.side.str.capitalize(); dump("moment_themes", th, "moment_themes.csv (s38_all_moments.py)")
cols = ["rank", "side", "name", "country", "overseas", "status", "balls", "ipl_balls", "score", "stat", "stat2", "fixes", "note"]
TOP["side"] = TOP.side.str.capitalize(); TOP = TOP.round(2); dump("fix_top", TOP[cols], "fix_scores.csv (s38_all_moments.py), players not in any 2027 squad")
rrs = RRS.copy(); rrs["side"] = rrs.side.str.capitalize(); dump("fix_rr", rrs[["side", "name", "balls", "score", "stat", "stat2", "fixes"]].round(2), "fix_scores.csv, RR 2027 squad")
dump("auction_plan", P, "fix_scores.csv, rivals2027.csv")
pd.set_option("display.width", 250); print(TOP[["side", "rank", "name", "country", "status", "balls", "score", "stat"]].to_string(index=False))
